history.content: Draft a note telling our landlord the heater is broken again. Firm but friendly.

Here's the draft: "Hi [Landlord's name], The heater has stopped working again, this is a repeat issue, and with the weather cooling off it's not something we can wait on. Could you get someone out to fix it in the next day or two? If it's easier, send me the repair contact directly and we'll coordinate. We've appreciated how responsive you've been in the past, so hoping we can get this sorted quickly. Thanks, Alex" Two things before I stage it as an email: who's it addressed to (name and email), and is "again" twice or more? If it's the third time, I'd add a line noting the pattern, firmer, still friendly.
